thread:
Incident Bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx spike on ingress-gateway for prod detected (>5% errors over 5m). Paging on-call. Correlation root: `cid=prod-abc123`. Runbook: <https://console.redwood/runbooks/ingress-5xx>.

Ryan (oncall): I'm on it, starting triage. Posting initial impact numbers once I get the dashboard.

Eli (CS): FYI customer acme-co reporting timeouts around 11:42 UTC, support ticket #TCK-8123. They're seeing internal retries and a 502 in their logs.

Maya (support): Confirmed multiple customers, peak error rate ~11:40-11:48 UTC. Top affected routes: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat/stream`.

Sara (eng): Can someone grab a few sample request logs + the correlation id mapping? Need to see gateway -> router -> runtime chain.

Dmitri (SRE): Query I ran against logstore: 
```
# find recent requests with cid
gcloud logging read "jsonPayload.corr_id=\"prod-abc123\" AND resource.labels.service=\"ingress-gateway\"" --limit 50 --format=json
```
Sample extracted lines (sanitized):
```
ingress-gateway: request_id=req-9a1b cid=prod-abc123 path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=router-12 attempts=1
router-12: request_id=req-9a1b cid=prod-abc123 -> runtime-34 status=504 retry=3 latency_ms=3120
runtime-34: request_id=req-9a1b cid=prod-abc123 status=500 error="out-of-memory: kv-cache alloc failed"
```
Looks like runtime returned 500 and router retried 3x causing amplified failures.

Ryan (oncall): Good catch. Hypothesis A: runtime OOMs under a specific model infer pattern -> 5xx. Hypothesis B: router retry policy is too aggressive causing request amplification when runtimes are flapping.

Kevin (ML): We rolled a model config yesterday that increases max_seq and uses larger KV per request; that could cause memory spikes on certain inputs.

Sara (eng): Timeline so far (UTC):
- 11:38 first small error blip in infra metrics
- 11:40 error rate climbs >1%
- 11:42 paging threshold crossed (5%) -> pager fired
- 11:44 bulk of customer reports arrive
- 11:46 router retries spike concurrently with runtime 500s
- 11:50 mitigation: scaled runtime pool x2 (in progress)

Dmitri (SRE): Putting quick log extract into shared bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1901234567/ (contains router + runtime traces, grep ready).

Maya (support): Adding customer-impact notes to incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/1901234567-impact (customer list, severity, CS contact).

Ryan (oncall): Immediate mitigations applied:
- increased runtime replicas by 2 (manual scale)
- temporarily lowered router retry count from 3 -> 1 for prod (to reduce amplification)
- added a short-lived circuit-breaker for runtime-34 (quarantine)
Early signals: error rate dropping to ~2% after scale+retry-change.

Eli (CS): Confirmed acme-co still seeing 1-2 failing requests but majority are recovered. They're OK with current mitigation but want root cause.

Sara (eng): Action items (owners):
- Sara: collect heap/dump from runtime-34 and check model config change -> `/deploys/2026-03-14` (in progress)
- Dmitri: run a post-mortem search for other runtimes with similar OOM signature in last 48h (assigned)
- Kevin: roll back model config if we reproduce locally (standby)
- Ryan: keep monitoring, prepare to handoff to oncall backup in 30m if stable

Dmitri (SRE): Quick grep for similar errors shows 2 other runtimes with `kv-cache alloc failed` in last 24h but at lower frequency. Saving traces to the bucket.

Sara (eng): Paste of relevant runtime log frame (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T11:46:12Z] runtime-34 ERROR request=req-9a1b cid=prod-abc123 model=redwood/large seq=1024 mem_usage=14.8GB limit=16GB kv_alloc=failed stack="alloc.cpp:421"
[2026-03-15T11:46:12Z] runtime-34 WARN GC starting free=1.2GB
[2026-03-15T11:46:15Z] runtime-34 ERROR OOM during KV attach, returning 500
```
This aligns with OOM hypothesis.

Kevin (ML): If model config increased kv per seq, memory pressure is expected for long sequences. Suggest reverting the config for prod and running A/B on a non-prod cluster.

Ryan (oncall): Immediate next steps:
1) keep retry policy reduced (Dmitri to confirm router config persists)
2) Sara/Kevin decide on config rollback within 2 hours
3) Dmitri run a health sweep to ensure no other runtime under similar stress
4) I will update status page and customer-facing Slack with preliminary mitigation note.

Maya (support): Customer note draft: "We're seeing elevated errors due to backend capacity issues affecting some requests. Mitigations are underway, and most customers are seeing recovery. We'll follow up with RCA." Ready to publish once Ryan posts. :thumbsup:

Ryan (oncall): Handing off active triage to Sara in 25m, will remain reachable. If error rate doesn't fall below 1% after rollback/scale, escalate to incident leader.

Sara (eng): Acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate the RCA, collect logs from s3://redwood-incident-logs/1901234567/, and draft a timeline + root cause. Will include correlation IDs and a checklist of config changes.

Dmitri (SRE): Marking this thread for postmortem tagging: #prod-5xx #runtime-oom #retry-amplification.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate down to ~1.8% (last 5m). Next update in 15m or on new major event.

Ryan (oncall): Leaving now for short break, Sara taking over. Thanks all for quick responses. :raised_hands:

Sara (eng): Continuing triage — saving this as the root thread. Will share draft RCA in this channel when ready.
